justification: Each internal requires is exactly an original public equivalent requires instantiated at batch=n and output=left or right. Public left/right separation ensures preservation across calls. Both kernel bodies, assigns, termination and every call precondition remain checked. Explicit Pre labels avoid post-state pointer/length vacuity. No public spec or ordinary C modification.
vcmul_justification: Public n>0, n<=SIZE_MAX/16-3 implies n*sizeof(float) positive, no wrap, divisible by sizeof(float) and N=n. Input/output/padding and separation exactly instantiate each public clause; no input_a/input_b separation or params validity added. Actual kernel bodies/assigns/termination and both calls must be checked. Reference preserves original non-fused IEEE multiply-subtract/add order; output pointers and lengths explicitly Pre-anchored.
integer_justification: Integer cases: batch=n, output=left/right. Every requires directly instantiates the frozen public spec; output separation preserves earlier results. No new multiplier or input bounds. Both actual bodies, private frame/termination, helper bodies and all call preconditions remain checked. Original logical expressions (including wrap, rounding and saturation) are unchanged. All post-state lengths, input values and parameter fields are explicitly Pre-anchored.
